title: Marrakesh Lentils
subtitle: with Sweet Potato, Broccolini and Wholegrains
description: Keep your winter nights warm with a bowl of nourishing lentils scented with Moroccan spices. Simmered with sweet potato and tomatoes, then piled on top of wholegrains, it's a wholesome bowl of goodness.

steps.text: Cook grain blend: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Halve the broccolini lengthwise. Add the grain blend to the pan of boiling water and cook for 20-22 mins until tender, adding the broccolini for the last 2 mins of cooking. Drain.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, peel the sweet potato, then cut into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon (see Cooking tip), then cut the lemon into wedges. Drain and rinse the lentils.
Cook spices: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Add the garlic and Moroccan seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer sweet potato: Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, 1 tbs tomato paste and 180ml (¾ cup) water to the pan and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, for 15 mins or until the sweet potato is tender. Stir in the lentils and cook for 1 min or until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the grain blend, lentils and broccolini among bowls, scatter over the lemon zest and serve with the lemon wedges for squeezing over. Enjoy!

Did you know?: Our grain blend contains black barley, a highly nutritious grain with a nutty, slightly sweet flavour and chewy texture. It is the only grain that can go from field to fork without any processing.
